text:
Situation: Amoxicillin and clavulanate potassium has been on FDA's shortage list since 2022-10-28 and remains listed as of 2026-10-21, a duration of 48 months. Corvale East holds 294 units of the 200mg/5ml 100ml bottle at 15.3 units per day (19 days on hand). Corvale General holds 823 units of amoxicillin and clavulanate potassium at 30.8 units per day (27 days on hand). Separate amoxicillin stock at Corvale General is 397.41 units with 26 days on hand.

Why (FDA record): FDA's shortage list shows the product posted continuously since 2022-10-28. FDA has not stated a cause for the shortage in the provided records. NuCare Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (FEI 3003294404) is a registered relabel plant; its most recent inspection ended 2020-01-10 with a VAI classification. Asclemed USA Inc. DBA ENOVACHEM (FEI 3001452204) is another registered relabel plant; it received an OAI classification after an inspection ending 2018-09-27.

Our position: Current inventory provides 19 to 27 days of supply across sites. The rule-ranked option is Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc., which is not on FDA's shortage list today and operates plants in Jordan (2INAMOXU24N-E and 2INAMOXU12N). Sandoz Inc. and Teva Pharmaceuticals USA, Inc. are also not on the shortage list and should be checked for availability.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place orders with Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. as primary source; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition if not currently stocked.
2. Buyer to contact Sandoz Inc. for quote and availability confirmation; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition if not currently stocked.
3. Buyer to contact Teva Pharmaceuticals USA, Inc. for quote and availability confirmation; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition if not currently stocked.
4. Buyer to evaluate A-S Medication Solutions and Chartwell RX, LLC only if options 1-3 cannot fulfill needs; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.

Not recommended: Do not wait for current stock to deplete below 14 days before executing purchases. Do not assume relabel plants NuCare or Asclemed USA Inc. can resolve supply given inspection histories and lack of FDA-stated shortage cause.
